intro.title: Cooking
intro.text: Limited ingredients, limited time and a meal that still has to hit its macros. The constraints don't block the design, they define it.

dishes.alt: Avocado, egg and tomato on a biscuit, plated on a white plate
dishes.name: Breakfast biscuit
dishes.note: Quick breakfast, plated with care. It lasts about two minutes before I scarf it down.

dishes.alt: Glazed ribs topped with sesame seeds and sliced scallions in a glass baking dish.
dishes.name: Chinese NY rib
dishes.note: Invited to a Chinese New Year party. I know the flavors but not the cooking, so I twisted a dish I know well.

dishes.alt: Glazed chicken thigh with rice and green beans on a white plate
dishes.name: Glazed thigh
dishes.note: Meal prep gets boring. A glaze is all it takes to dress up classic chicken and rice.

dishes.alt: Braised baby bok choy in a white bowl
dishes.name: Italian bok choy
dishes.note: All that was left was Italian sausage and bok choy, fusion was the only option.

dishes.alt: Breaded katsu cutlet on pesto pasta on a white plate
dishes.name: Katsu pesto
dishes.note: Katsu usually gets curry. I say a fresh, creamy pesto suits that crispy cutlet better.
